entries.title: Your first mate no longer stops to say a queued task started
entries.body: When a queued task starts because what it waited for finished, your first mate sees it with its next message instead of taking a turn of its own to tell you. This saves your plan's allowance on busy days. It still tells you when a queued task could not start, or started on another model than the one you named.
entries.noPicture: This changes when the first mate is woken, not a view or control.
